## Description

Service Bus namespace (private endpoint) and queues with dead-letter; outbox dispatcher publishes opaque job ids; Worker.Ai (.NET 10, Microsoft.Extensions.AI) authenticates with its own managed identity, calls a restricted internal API to re-check consent/tenant/retention and obtain short-lived audio access, and returns results through an authenticated internal callback. Prompts and model versions are versioned files in the repo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The worker identity has no database permissions (verified in infra test) and cannot call public endpoints beyond the internal API.
- [ ] **AC2.** Duplicate delivery of the same job produces exactly one logical result (idempotency test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Poison messages go to dead-letter with an alert; no PHI in message bodies.
- [ ] **AC4.** Each AI run records model ref, prompt hash, schema version and region.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
